messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: blavaan 0.3-1 is released on CRAN
parts:
Christoph,

I have seen some issues where Rstudio installs packages in a different location than R, then doesn't find the packages that you installed in R. So maybe your Rstudio versions of blavaan and lavaan are not up to date. You might try installing the development versions, which have some bug fixes:

install.packages("lavaan", repos="http://www.da.ugent.be", type="source")

install.packages("blavaan", repos="http://faculty.missouri.edu/~merklee", type="source")


Best,
Ed

parts:
Esther,

Thanks for the clarification. I just tried this out with your versions of lavaan and blavaan (I had not tried the newest version of lavaan), and it seems to be working for me. Two possibilities come to mind, though I'm not sure whether either will solve the problem:

1. Rstudio sometimes installs packages in a different location than R, and you end up using older versions of packages when you think you are using newer versions. You might check whether this code works in R, outside of Rstudio.

2. You might load blavaan before (instead of) lavaan. That is, instead of

library(lavaan)
library(blavaan)

Try just using

library(blavaan)

which also loads lavaan as a side effect. Let me know!

Ed
